program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height = len(out)
    width = len(out[0])
    for col in range(width):
        if out[height - 1][col] == 5:
            color = 5
            for row in range(height - 1, -1, -1):
                if out[row][col] != 0:
                    color = out[row][col]
                else:
                    out[row][col] = color
    return out
'''
